Argon2 reference implementation from P-H-C/phc-winner-argon2, revision f57e61e19229e23c4445b85494dbf7c07de721cb.
The portable .sqv format uses Argon2id v1.3, t=3, m=65536 KiB, p=4, output=32 bytes.
Sources are unmodified; compile ARGON2_NO_THREADS=1 with the reference fill implementation.
Upstream LICENSE offers CC0 or Apache-2.0; this integration uses the CC0 option.
